title: Hyve -Tropical Peach -Walk to Broadway -Pool & Gym
description:
Tropical Peach is your stylish Nashville escape, where laid-back comfort meets resort-style living. Lounge in the cozy open living area, enjoy morning coffee on your private patio or balcony, and take full advantage of top-tier amenities like the seasonal pool, fire-pit courtyard, BBQ grills, and modern fitness center. When adventure calls, stroll to The Gulch for rooftop cocktails and upscale dining, or walk to Broadway for honky-tonks, live music, and neon-lit nights.

The space
⭐ Building Accommodations & Amenities:
- Nestled in a prime location on the border of SOBRO, The Gulch, & Pie Town
- 12-minute walk to Broadway
- Seasonal outdoor pool (open March 1 – end of October, 10 am –10 pm, HOA discretion)
- Exclusive access to Hyve’s top-tier building amenities
- Outdoor pool area - Covered cabanas, sun loungers, and a wheelchair lift
- Shared outdoor courtyard - Communal BBQ grill with a kitchenette area, ping pong table, and multiple fire-pit lounge areas
- Fitness Center - Wide range of workout equipment and a smart TV
- Communal Area - Modern lobby lounge featuring a kitchenette, electric fireplace, and multiple hangout areas
- Private balcony with outdoor seating outside of the 2nd bedroom
- Private patio with outdoor seating and an outdoor dining area
- In-Unit Washer & Dryer

🛋️ Living Areas:
- Open-floor living area
- Cozy furnishings
- Smart TV
- Coffee table
- Access to a private patio 

🍽️ Kitchen & Dining:
- Fully equipped kitchen
- Stainless steel appliances
- Fridge, dishwasher, oven, 4-burner stove, microwave & toaster
- Kitchen island with bar seating for 4 guests
- Keurig coffee maker with coffee  
- Kitchen Starter Kit: 2 dishwashing tablets, dish soap, 1 dish sponge, 2 laundry detergent pods, disinfectant wipes, 2 paper towel rolls, 10 trash bags, 1 coffee bag, and 4 coffee filters

🛌 Bedrooms:
- Primary Bedroom: 1 King bed with a smart TV, large closet space, and designer furnishings
- 2nd Bedroom: 2 Queen beds with a walk-in closet, en-suite bathroom, and access to a private balcony

🛁 Bathrooms:
- Primary Bedroom: Single vanity with a shower/tub combo
- 2nd Bedroom: Dual vanity with a stand-in shower
- Bathroom Starter Kits: 1 shampoo, 1 conditioner, 1 body wash, 1 hand bar soap, 1 makeup wipe, 2 liners for trash can, and 2 rolls of toilet paper

🚗 Parking:
- Parking is provided on a first-come, first-served basis in the covered parking garage on the premises
- If no garage spaces are available upon arrival, ample street parking is also available on a first-come, first-served basis  

🎉 Special offers exclusive to Hyve guests:
When you book a stay at Hyve, you also get access to exclusive discounts for shops within the building and activities nearby! Such as:
25% off 60 min Yoga class at Art Gallery Yoga or IV Therapy
20% off piercings, gold jewelry & custom tattoos at Iris Nashville
10% off at Luxe Redux Bridal
& more seasonal offers!

Whether you’re here to soak up the music, explore Nashville’s hottest neighborhoods, or unwind in resort-style comfort, Tropical Peach delivers the perfect balance of energy and relaxation. From poolside afternoons to Broadway nights, every stay is set up for unforgettable memories.

🧳 Luggage Holding Service:
In our ongoing commitment to enhance your rental experience, we are delighted to introduce a complimentary service to hold your luggage for a designated period. **Subject to Availability** The luggage holding service is available from Monday - Sunday | 9:30 am - 5:30 pm. Oversized luggage exceeding 50 lbs. will not be accepted.

❗️Notes to Guests & Important Details:
- Please note this unit is located on the 2nd floor of the building; however, an elevator is available on-site.
- The pool is open seasonally (open March 1 – end of October, 10 am –10 pm, HOA discretion) but may close due to extreme weather. Hours of operation are from 10 am to 10 pm.
- This building is adjacent to railroad tracks, and some units may experience noise from passing trains. While this particular unit is located in the front of the building, you may occasionally hear the train if you are out on the balcony or at the pool.
- Our location is in the heart of downtown Nashville, an exciting and growing urban area. Like many downtown environments, guests may encounter typical city sounds such as music, traffic, sirens, other tourists, and construction, as well as see individuals seeking assistance from a nearby shelter. While most guests find this to be a vibrant and welcoming area, we understand that urban settings are not for everyone. We do not recommend staying in Downtown Nashville if this is something you are sensitive to.  It is important to note that Hyve is a secure building with professional on-site security. 
- We manage multiple units within this building, each thoughtfully designed for comfort and style. While all units maintain a consistent standard quality, sizes and décor vary. If the unit you are viewing is not the best fit for your stay, let us know, and we will help you find one that better suits your group. 
- Download the DOOR: Smart Access & Control App from the provided check-in instruction email to access the unit door code, including the communal door code that will work for the Lobby, Elevator, Gym, and Pool. The DOOR app is required for use during your stay.
